maria-chen: Quick question — I'm updating Go/Py SDK error mapping. How do we want to surface 429 vs 5xx for streaming reconnects? Also confirm request-id header name to propagate (X-RW-Request-Id?).

kevin-hall: cc @samir — we agreed on `X-RW-Request-Id` (header case-insensitive). Map 429 -> RateLimitError (attach Retry-After if present). 5xx -> ServerError. For 5xx, set `is_transient` true for 502/503/504, false for 500 unless we see repeated failures.

samir: For streaming, prefer a `StreamDisconnected` exception that wraps the cause. Keep `request_id` on every exception object and include `http_status` and `raw_body` when available. If stream resumed successfully after a retry, surface a `StreamResumeWarning` in logs.

ada: I pushed a small PR for the Python exceptions shape — PTAL: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pull/4235

maria-chen: Here's the mapping snippet I was testing:
```python
# simplified mapping
if status == 429:
    raise RateLimitError(message=msg, request_id=headers.get("X-RW-Request-Id"), retry_after=headers.get("Retry-After"))
elif 500 <= status < 600:
    raise ServerError(message=msg, request_id=headers.get("X-RW-Request-Id"), http_status=status, is_transient=(status in (502,503,504)))
else:
    raise APIError(message=msg, request_id=headers.get("X-RW-Request-Id"), http_status=status)
```

kevin-hall: Logging guide: always log `request_id`, `route`, `model`, and `token_count`. Use `logger.warning` for 4xx, `logger.error` for 5xx. Include the original root RID in retry logs (don't replace it). Add debug-level full payload only behind a flag.

maria-chen: Quick Q on propagation: should SDK prefer the server-provided header, or preserve a client-generated trace id? For retries we want to correlate to the original root request.

samir: Preserve original root RID in the request context (ctx.root_request_id). If the server returns a different RID, put it in `server_request_id` but keep `root_request_id` for correlation. For internal spans, set parent to root rid.

ci-bot: Build passed (master) :white_check_mark:

ada: small nit: rename `ServerError.retryable` -> `ServerError.is_transient` to avoid implying automatic retry.

maria-chen: Thanks. I'll update the Go and Py mappings, add unit tests for header parsing and streaming resume, and include a small doc snippet under /docs/sdks/error-handling.md. Will ping when PRs are up.

kevin-hall: Thanks — ping me for a quick review. :thumbsup:
